summary: Authenticated read-only Cloudflare gateway, OAuth PKCE, one-time device pairing, private management dashboard and bounded outbound polling contract.
decisions: Separate private Access-protected dashboard/consent origin from public OAuth discovery and bearer-protected MCP origin.
Verify Cloudflare application JWT signature, issuer, audience, expiry and explicit owner allowlist independently at the Worker.
OAuth uses single-use S256 codes, exact registered callback, resource/scope binding, rotating refresh credentials and revocation epochs; opaque tokens are hashed at rest.
Use one SQLite Durable Object for private staging metadata and bounded request delivery; no D1 database, tunnel or inbound workstation port is needed.
Reuse the device agent's versioned read-only contract; filesystem implementation remains in FileService on the selected computer.
Delivered jobs never return to the queue; cancellation survives client result consumption. Temporary results are removed after delivery and expire automatically.
Keep remote writes/processes disabled and expose that limit in discovery, consent and dashboard.
No full parity closure or latest-2026 MCP conformance is claimed from these tests. Supported protocol revisions are 2025-11-25, 2025-06-18 and 2025-03-26.

tests.result: RED before implementation, then 14/14 PASS on Linux Node24.22.1. Real cryptographic JWT signatures, PKCE, pairing, queued request delivery, cross-user/device rejection, token rotation/replay, revocation, cancellation, expiry, bounded input, cleanup continuation and storage-fault injection.

tests.command: Independent security review and registry reproductions
tests.result: Found and fixed cleanup postponement, pending authorization/pairing revocation, consent CSP callback, pairing crash replay, strict Access service identity, optional MCP arguments and consumed-cancellation race. Independent reviewer reran 14/14 PASS and found no remaining concrete blocker for restricted staging.
Pending at this checkpoint; managed staging identity creation alone is not deployment or real MCP acceptance.

roadmap_updates.assessment: Implementation evidence added with no broad stage or parity acceptance increase at this checkpoint. External staging/Windows and human-client acceptance remain distinct gates.

limitations: 14 groups use synthetic identities and an in-memory Durable Object storage fixture; actual Cloudflare runtime and Windows agent must be checked separately.
Human Google sign-in/consent and ChatGPT connector installation require owner consent and are not represented by service-principal tests.
Private staging limits: 20 active devices per identity, 32 grants, 200 retained requests, 128 audit events per identity, 20-second jobs; scale certification remains open.
No remote write or process execution activation, no autostart service, no production promotion at this checkpoint.
next_unverified_action: Integrate the tested device agent, run the full Windows/package gates, deploy the identical hashed artifact to isolated staging and execute a real MCP SDK read from a dedicated Windows fixture root.
